lines: Lie flat, feet on the floor, dumbbells beside your chest.
Press up until your arms are straight over your chest.
Lower slowly until the dumbbells reach chest level.
Dumbbell_Bench_Press.focus: Focus: chest. Front shoulders and triceps help.

lines: Bench on a low incline, dumbbells at your upper chest.
Press up and slightly in until your arms are straight.
Lower under control back to the upper chest.
Incline_Dumbbell_Press.focus: Focus: upper chest. Front shoulders and triceps help.

lines: Sit tall against the back rest, dumbbells at your shoulders.
Press straight up until your arms are straight.
Lower back to shoulder height before the next rep.
Stand tall, dumbbells at your sides, elbows a little bent.
Raise your arms out to the side up to shoulder height.
Lower slowly, no swinging from the hips.
Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands, arms straight.
Bend the elbows to lower it behind your head.
Keep the upper arms still and straighten back up.
Standing_Dumbbell_Triceps_Extension.focus: Focus: triceps, the back of the upper arm.

lines: Hands a bit wider than shoulders, body in one straight line.
Lower your chest close to the floor.
Push back up until your arms are straight.
Pushups.focus: Focus: chest. Front shoulders and triceps help.

lines: One knee and hand on the bench, back flat, arm hanging.
Pull the dumbbell up to your hip, elbow close to your side.
Lower until the arm is straight again, then switch sides.
One-Arm_Dumbbell_Row.focus: Focus: middle back. Lats, biceps and rear shoulder help.

lines: Sit under the pads, hands wide on the bar, chest up.
Pull the bar down to your upper chest, elbows down and back.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.
Wide-Grip_Lat_Pulldown.focus: Focus: lats, the wide muscles of the back.

lines: Chest on an incline bench, dumbbells hanging, elbows soft.
Open your arms out to the side up to shoulder level.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then lower slowly.
Reverse_Flyes.focus: Focus: rear shoulders. Upper back helps.

lines: Stand tall, arms straight, palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells up with your elbows fixed at your sides.
Lower all the way until your arms are straight.
Stand tall, palms facing your body, thumbs up.
Curl up to shoulder height, elbows fixed at your sides.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Hammer_Curls.focus: Focus: biceps and the top of the forearm.

lines: Hold one weight at your chest, feet about shoulder width.
Sit down between your knees, chest up, as deep as you can.
Stand back up by pushing the floor away.
Goblet_Squat.focus: Focus: thighs (quads). Glutes and hamstrings help.

lines: Stand tall, dumbbells in front, knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and lower the weights along your legs.
Keep your back flat and stand up by driving the hips forward.
Stiff-Legged_Dumbbell_Deadlift.focus: Focus: hamstrings. Glutes and lower back help.

lines: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand.
Step forward and lower until both knees are bent.
Push through the front heel to step back, then switch legs.
Lie face down, pad just above your heels, hips on the bench.
Curl your heels toward your glutes and hold a moment.
Lower slowly until your legs are straight.
Lying_Leg_Curls.focus: Focus: hamstrings, the back of the thigh.
Lying_Leg_Curls.tempo: Lift 1 s · Hold 1 s · Lower 2 s

lines: Balls of your feet on the edge, knees straight.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can and hold.
Lower your heels slowly for a full stretch.
Standing_Calf_Raises.tempo: Lift 1 s · Hold 1 s · Lower 2 s

lines: Lie flat, dumbbells above your chest, elbows slightly bent.
Open your arms in a wide arc until the chest stretches.
Bring them back up along the same arc, squeezing the chest.
Sit with back support, dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press up until your arms are straight above you.
Lower slowly back to the shoulders.
Pulleys high, one step forward, slight lean, elbows soft.
Bring your hands together in front of you in a wide arc.
Squeeze a moment, then open back up slowly.
Cable_Crossover.tempo: Pull 1 s · Hold 1 s · Return 2 s

lines: Stand tall at a high pulley, upper arms at your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Let it rise slowly, elbows staying where they are.
Triceps_Pushdown.focus: Focus: triceps, the back of the upper arm.
Triceps_Pushdown.tempo: Push 1 s · Hold 1 s · Return 2 s

lines: Hands on a bench behind you, legs out in front.
Bend your elbows to lower your body, elbows pointing back.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms.
Bench_Dips.focus: Focus: triceps. Chest and front shoulders help.

lines: Hinge forward with a flat back, knees soft, arms hanging.
Pull both dumbbells to your sides, elbows close to the body.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Bent_Over_Two-Dumbbell_Row.focus: Focus: middle back. Lats and biceps help.

lines: Sit tall, knees soft, arms reaching for the handle.
Pull the handle to your stomach, elbows close to your sides.
Squeeze your back, then let the arms reach forward slowly.
Seated_Cable_Rows.focus: Focus: middle back. Lats and biceps help.

lines: Rope on a high pulley, step back, arms straight.
Pull the rope to your face, hands apart, elbows high.
Hold a moment, then let the arms return slowly.
Face_Pull.focus: Focus: rear shoulders. Upper back helps.
Face_Pull.tempo: Pull 1 s · Hold 1 s · Return 2 s

lines: Sit back on an incline bench, arms hanging straight down.
Curl up while the upper arms stay still.
Lower all the way for a long stretch at the bottom.
Sit, upper arm resting on the inside of your thigh.
Curl the dumbbell up with only the forearm moving.
Squeeze at the top, lower slowly, then switch arms.
Concentration_Curls.tempo: Lift 1 s · Hold 1 s · Lower 2 s

lines: Back flat on the pad, feet shoulder width on the platform.
Lower the platform until your knees bend to about 90 degrees.
Push through your heels, stop just short of locked knees.
Leg_Press.focus: Focus: thighs (quads). Glutes and hamstrings help.

lines: Dumbbells at your sides, one foot fully on the box.
Step up by pushing through that top foot.
Step down slowly, then finish the reps and switch legs.
Sit back, pad on the front of your shins, hold the handles.
Straighten your legs and squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly to the start.
Leg_Extensions.tempo: Lift 1 s · Hold 1 s · Lower 2 s

lines: Sit, ball of one foot on a block, dumbbell on that knee.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can and hold.
Lower the heel slowly for a full stretch, then switch.
Dumbbell_Seated_One-Leg_Calf_Raise.tempo: Lift 1 s · Hold 1 s · Lower 2 s
